integrationPolicy: One isolated branch; code entire fleet batch before G1 integration, final checks and protected merge. Incremental development commits allowed on that branch, no per-hull maintained integration.
baselineMeaning: Explicit runtime routing count from coordinator verified inventory, not gameplay acceptance. All 171 remain in final acceptance scope.

geometryIndex.status: Geometry handoff and metadata only, not native/game acceptance; later per-ID corrections take precedence.

workDefinitions.AUTHORITY: Use exact current R3 name, role, performance, access, accommodation, fitting and acquisition contract; preserve selected later per-ID geometry/physical winners. Resolve explicit missing design choices without reusing old aliases or inventing equipment/crew grants.
workDefinitions.RESOURCE: Install original full geometry, materials, textures, UVs and legitimate notices. Replace old model/profile/name/alias dependencies. Candidate assets without runtime use do not count as connected.
workDefinitions.PHYSICAL: Provide calibrated per-ID units, qualified closed native collision at the existing face cap, actual port where applicable, and a justified physical mass/inertia/energy contract. Preserve authored gaps/material and real limitations; no proxy/cap waiver or assumed equivalence.
workDefinitions.RUNTIME: Connect strict loader/catalogue/definition/physical routing. No family-name/default preview/old-generated/native alias fallback. Pending-only assets do not satisfy this task.
workDefinitions.PERSISTENCE: Make fresh/current save-load, custody, ownership, discovery and receipts coherent with the existing writer. No migration or old-save compatibility layer.
workDefinitions.TESTS: Implement meaningful per-ID and shared regression coverage for load, physical admission, acquisition, fitting/crew, NPC/salvage, save and failure rollback; register genuine method identities. Run through G1 after the coherent batch is coded.
workDefinitions.RENDER: After coding, G1 generates actual full-fleet views and README-scale media; inspect all views, glazing supports, ports, materials and dimensions.
workDefinitions.GAME: After integration, G1 verifies actual ordinary gameplay paths and records evidence; static source checks and controlled fixture setup are not completed game journeys.
workDefinitions.STATION_SERVICE: Connect correct original station population/sites/services/docking, living body and history/loss rules, source authority and never-purchase rules; preserve selected SH028 versus secondary-station policies.
workDefinitions.NPC: Connect actual supported NPC roles, availability/placement, native body construction, damage, crew/custody and salvage. Declared metadata alone is insufficient.
workDefinitions.ACQUISITION: Implement exact R3/selected later purchase or earned blueprint policy, paid exchange, prerequisite/milestone/discovery validation, quote-confirm freshness and writer rollback. EMP disable or a kill alone must not grant salvage blueprints unless expressly authorized.
workDefinitions.FIT_CREW: Enforce actual paid equipment, capacity, cargo, accommodation and finite crew requirements, default bare-hull limits and normal launch checks; no free role kit or invisible stock.
workDefinitions.MEDUSA_Q01: Connect all core clues/PLUGH and ordered finale prerequisites, actual EMP disable, lawful physical cut/scoop and receiving. Preserve paid-stock versus upgraded outcomes; not kill-only.
workDefinitions.CAPSULE_ESCAPE: Connect actual escape-pod launch, physical occupancy, damage, rescue/custody and durable outcomes; preserve its explicit nonstandard access instead of forcing normal player-hull purchase.
workDefinitions.PLATFORM_SERVICE: Connect original platform placement, physical body and services, damage/discovery/collection rules and never-purchase policy as the per-ID R3 contract requires.
workDefinitions.PROBE_BEHAVIOR: Connect the original probe/object-specific native behavior, encounter and damage/discovery/current-save rules; do not force a normal ship adapter.
